Hi Tom — thanks for the context and Monica for the heads-up. A few notes from Finance: 

- Eligibility: We typically evaluate early-pay on a per-account basis. For new vendors, we require a completed onboarding form, W-9, bank verification, and one month of invoice history (or a signed PO we can use for the pilot).
- Proposal: If Sentinel wants 2% for Net 10, Finance will model the cost against the pilot size. For quick approval, consider Net 30 with a 1% 10-day discount for the first two invoices — that's a common compromise.
- PO routing: Please confirm the receiving email for PO acknowledgements (options: procure@sentineldyn.com or a dedicated AP mailbox). We will issue POs in our system and send EDI/PO emails to the address you confirm.

Action items for you, Tom: upload W-9 and bank_details.csv to the portal and confirm PO acknowledgement email. Monica — once those are in, can you create a mutual action plan (MAP) and assign internal owners? I'll run the early-pay analysis and come back with a recommended discount and expected payment workflow by Thursday EOD PT.
